correctness.rationale: For every prime power q and m,n≥2, projective-scalar rank-one coordinates are unique. On the q−2 nontrivial multiplicative-character sectors, Gauss sums and projective incidence orthogonality A_eta A_eta*=q^(k−1)I give q^((m+n−1)/2). On the trivial sector A_1²=q^(k−2)(I+(q−1)J); four tensor eigenspaces give the remaining four levels and multiplicities, summing to |S|. L>0 including q=2,m=n=2. Independent reconstruction q=2,m=n=2 gives squared singular levels 1 once, 4 four times and 16 four times, consistent with claimed unnormalized coordinatewise pairing. General statement follows algebraically, not from finite numerical checks.
